# Carlo Alberto Degli Atti (lordkada)

> Product & Innovation Leader based in Milan, Italy, with over 25 years in tech. Product Lead at PagoPA S.p.A., the state-controlled company behind Italy's public digital payments and services platforms. Serial founder of six companies across Italy and the United States, and a computer scientist who still builds hands-on: AI agents, local-first computer vision, and research on artificial valence.

The site is a single page in two languages. The Italian version is the default; the English one is a translation with the same content.

## Profile

- [Profile, English](https://lordkada.it/en/): about, how I work, experience, side projects, writing, education
- [Profilo, italiano](https://lordkada.it/): the same page in Italian

## Highlights

- PagoPA (2021–now): laid the groundwork for and launched the Developer Portal, the first developer portal of the Italian Public Administration, used by thousands of public bodies and technology partners; released DOS68K, an open-source RAG platform spun off from the portal's AI assistant.
- HELLO Mobility (2020–2021): product manager for the build and production launch of the HELLO app (parking, EV charging, micromobility).
- International STEM Awards (2019–2020): co-founder of a platform for STEM projects by young people aged 7–25; the first edition gathered 118 projects from about 300 participants in 10 countries.
- Thingle.me (2015–2019, CEO): customer support software for physical products via QR code or NFC; launched Thingly, a conversational AI assistant for appliances, in 2018.
- Styloola (2014, CTO): led the development of the Styloola Box, an in-store Wi-Fi analytics device for fashion retail.
- Opinionage (2011–2015, CEO, San Francisco): the social network of opinions, later the HUBNGO community platform for SMEs.
- Couponline (2004–2009, co-founder and CTO): ScontoQui, personalised coupons delivered at the store entrance.
- Concept (2000–2011, CEO): myK, an Enterprise Feedback Management platform listed by Gartner in 2010 among the leading solutions.
